notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I've just updated the game to fix a bug. 
And now you can also run for a longer time, 
as I tried to balance the dash stamina better. 

If you've experienced any other bugs,
please let me know, either in the forums, 
via twitter or the support email. 

Thank you for you support! 
Have a lovely day.

- Plueschkatze.

notes.title: A Small Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

I updated the game to fix a number of minor bugs, which some kind players brought to my attention. 

[h1][b]PATCH NOTES:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a tiny layering issue with one of the maps.
[*]Changed how the jump stones across the river work, none of you should be accidently jumping across it any longer :) 
[*]Fixed a couple of other minor bugs. 
[/list]

[h1][b]OTHER NEWS:[/b][/h1]

The Ceress and Orea original soundtrack will release on May 1st. 

Ryan Fogleman, the composer, is collaborating with the people at Materia Collective to bring this amazing OST to you! 

I'll post another update on this soon. 


[h1]And I wanted to say a huge THANK YOU for the support, and for playing Ceress and Orea![/h1]


- Plueschkatze
